package  expo-constants ~57.0.21 (Expo-managed; belongs in every app)
step 2   (cd apps/alpha && npx expo install expo-constants@~57.0.21)
step 3   (cd apps/beta && npx expo install expo-constants@~57.0.21)
note     keep the @<spec> in each npx expo install: it writes the versions table's specifier
which can be a patch published that day; that patch stays a WARN with its due date in check-deps.ts
